description: LocalRouter on one Apple Silicon Mac (unified memory, Metal): chat, Drama 3 speech and Whisper transcription kept warm, KnowLine decisions and Qwen-Image on demand, each as an out-of-process server or cmd worker. Preview: the steps install and qualify every model, then the run ends; there is no service yet, so you start the daemon yourself (docs/dev/MAC-PORT.md, Installing on a Mac).
tested_on: M5 Ultra (96 GiB unified memory, macOS 27), 2026-10-30: every model installed, qualified and served through the daemon; no service yet

prereqs.title: jq, curl, git, tar, xz, shasum, python3
prereqs.test: for t in jq curl git tar xz shasum python3; do command -v $t > /dev/null || exit 1; done

prereqs.title: an Apple Silicon Mac (arm64)
prereqs.fix: none: Intel Macs have no unified memory for these models

prereqs.title: Zig 0.17.0 (builds LocalRouter)
prereqs.fix: brew install zig (Homebrew ships 0.17.0), or the pinned archive in host.tools.zig

prereqs.title: Xcode with its licence accepted and the Metal Toolchain (xcrun metal: builds Metal kernels from source; prebuilt release archives do not need it). When xcode-select points at the Command Line Tools, builds need DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer
prereqs.fix: install Xcode; sudo xcodebuild -license accept; sudo xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch; xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain; export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer (or sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app)

prereqs.title: python3 3.11 or newer (the cmd workers and the qualification scripts)

models.title: Fish Audio Drama 3 text to speech, NVFP4 pruned weights (drama-tensorfold's native TensorFold engine on Metal, six named voices, streamed 44.1 kHz)

licence.name: Fish Audio Community License v1.0 (no hosted service: keep the service on loopback or your tailnet)

accept: the Drama 3 weights' licence (FACL v1.0; link below): plotarmordev/drama-3-NVFP4-Pruned is an unofficial community quant of fishaudio/drama-3 under it
the native Metal engine's numerics as this Mac's Drama 3 baseline: not bit-exact with the GB10's CUDA build or the SGLang-Omni reference (qualify_macos.py --accept-native-numerics)
lossy weights: routed experts in NVFP4 and pruned to 7,369 of 10,240 (docs/dev/DRAMA3.md has their measured quality against the full model)
models.skip: leave tts out of --models; the Mac then has no speech model and the voice loop cannot speak

steps.title: the drama-tensorfold checkout, the patched Mac launcher, the six voices converted to the Metal catalog, the NVFP4 checkpoint (22.3 GB) and the Metal engine (Zig and Xcode's Metal compiler; about 3 minutes), every file against its pins
steps.fix: exit 3: Xcode's Metal compiler is missing or its licence not accepted (the xcode-metal prereq); network: run again (partial files resume); anything else: the last lines say which pin differs

steps.title: the qualify config: the Drama 3 tool from tools/speech/drama3/config.example-macos.json with this Mac's paths
steps.run: mkdir -p $J/qualify-drama3 && jq --arg src $REPO --arg root $DRAMA_ROOT --arg marker $DRAMA_MARKER --arg py $(command -v python3) --argjson port $DRAMA_PORT --arg data $J/qualify-drama3/data '.data_dir = $data | .tools[0].cmd = [$py, "-I", ($src + "/tools/speech/drama3/drama3_worker_macos.py")] | .tools[0].weights = $root | .tools[0].qualification = $marker | .tools[0].options.port = $port' $REPO/tools/speech/drama3/config.example-macos.json > $J/qualify-drama3/config.json

steps.title: the Metal qualification (assets, load, e2e, the six voices and a clone, memory; about 4 minutes), which writes the marker the service needs. Its first-audio gate is 0.55 s, not the GB10's 0.5 (guided warm first audio measures 0.52 s on an M5 Ultra; docs/dev/DRAMA3.md)
steps.fix: the run directory named on the last line (under $J/qualify-drama3/) has report.json, which says which step failed: not enough free memory: stop what holds the GPU; anything else: report it with that file
